title: ProjectAppVersions
description: Which Mirae versions wrote a project and which one it needs. `minimumVersion` is what an opening build compares itself against before it decides whether it can honour the file's required features (401 section 3).

minimumVersion.description: The oldest Mirae version that can open this project without losing intent.

savedByVersion.description: The Mirae version that last wrote this file, recorded for diagnostics rather than for compatibility decisions.
